title: helianthemum oelandicum subsp. vineale
intro: Helianthemum oelandicum subsp. vineale, commonly known as Rockrose or Vine-leaved Rockrose, is a plant species within the Helianthemum genus, native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, attributed to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum oelandicum subsp. vineale are primarily due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and free radical-scavenging properties.
